(2) Missing /app/server.js -> exit 0 with zero (68-70); any symlink outside /app/node_modules, or whose readlink -f target escapes it -> exit 0 (72-83). (3) /app copied to /tmp/submission (90-95); launched via setsid env -i with only PATH/NODE_PATH/HOME/PORT/DB_PATH under setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups (104-111), falling back to the copy if /app is not writable by 65534 (99-102). (4) Liveness: up to 120 x 0.25 s probes of /api/health then / before any RewardKit call; not ready -> exit 0 with zero (115-125). (5) Restart helper generated by heredoc + sed placeholders, chmod 755, APP_RESTART_HELPER exported (127-193). (6) {app_context} substituted into tests/*/*/prompt.md (195-201). (7) gates suite (budget 1500) then score.py: suite failure -> exit 0 with zero; score.py exit 0 continues, 1 stops keeping the detailed record (reward forced 0.0 because gates_passed is false, score.py:48), anything else -> write_zero_reward (212-222). (8) scored suite (11100) then score.py || write_zero_reward (224-227). Every exit path leaves a reward: before line 60 only mkdir/chmod of LOG_DIR can fail, where no reward file could be written anyway (template-controlled, latent P3 at most). If the scored suite times out or fails, the reward on disk is the gates-stage score.py record, which has reward 0.0 because scored/ was removed at line 212, so scored_ran=false and floors_passed=false (score.py:42-48). If score.py writes reward.json then raises on reward-details, the scored-stage '|| write_zero_reward' overwrites it with zero (conservative). score.py validates each dimension as finite in [0,1] (score.py:13-20). cleanup kills the app's process group via the possibly-updated app.pid (25-40). BUDGETS: judge timeouts gates 600+600=1200 < 1500, scored 9000+900+900=10800 < 11100 (--max-concurrent-agent 1), 1500+11100=12600 < 13200 verifier. CONTRACT DISCLOSURE: instruction.md:15 names node /app/server.js, port 3000, GET /api/health and DB_PATH; integration.md:21-23 and hireops_rules.md:207-209 tell the builder it runs from a different working directory under a locked-down account with only PATH/HOME/NODE_PATH/PORT/DB_PATH, so the cwd=/tests (mode 0700) launch does not fail a conforming app that resolves files relative to server.js. ADVERSARIAL: (a) broken app that could pass this row's liveness step: a stub returning HTTP 404 on every path counts as ready (HTTPError -> exit 0, lines 50-52) - by design, reachability is only a launch gate; the render/constraints gates and scored criteria must reject it (other rows). (b) conforming alternative that could fail: an app reading ./public relative to process.cwd() would fail under cwd /tests, but the brief explicitly tells the builder not to rely on the current directory, so this is disclosed, not hidden. LESSONS FILE: lesson 4 (keep gates simple) and lesson 11 (judge infra crashes zero a dimension) bear on this row - test.sh turns a crashed or timed-out suite into a recorded zero rather than an unscored rollout, but cannot distinguish an infra crash from an app failure (template behaviour, not a task defect); lesson 19 (golden harness launched like test.sh) - via-solve.sh runs solve.sh, chowns /app to 65534, then the driver launches node /app/server.js as uid 65534 with a cleared env from another cwd with a real restart (workspace.cjs:16; via-solve.log: all groups PASS; hashes re-verified), which approximates but is not test.sh itself.
